text:
incident-bot: ALERT: AUTH_RATE_SPIKE detected for /v1/auth. Error rate 5xx/429 elevated since 2809990000, auth service CPU at 88%, token churn high, >1200 failed exchanges in last 5m. Auto-pager triggered.

alice: taking this — I'm oncall. digging into top traces and client fingerprints.

bob: joining. pulling auth proxy logs and rate histograms. any immediate customer reports?

alice: seeing a ton of short-lived sessions from many distinct IPs, common patterns: rotating residential proxies, same UA patterns, high concurrency per account. 429s concentrated at /v1/auth/refresh and /v1/login.

emily: security chiming in — this looks like credential-stuffing via a proxy farm, likely automated. multiple failed password attempts across many accounts. recommend immediate mitigations: per-account throttles, challenge flows, and WAF block on suspect fingerprints.

frank: propose live mitigations now: 1) enable stricter per-account request quota (slice to 20 req/min) 2) apply quick WAF rule for the proxy header combos 3) temporarily remove batch-login endpoint.

alice: applying per-account quota slice now (rolling policy). command: `POST /admin/quotas/apply {"scope":"account","limit":20,"interval":"1m","reason":"live credential spray mitigation"}` — done for 100% of auth gw, should be live in ~30s.

bob: enabling WAF rule to block header fingerprint: `if (header.x-forwarded-for in rotate-proxy-set && header.user-agent =~ /okhttp|curl|python-requests/) block` — deploying rule in edge WAF. also adding rate-limit on /v1/auth/refresh to 5r/s global for anonymous IPs.

carla: support here — we already have ~8 customers reporting login failures and longer auth latency. drafting short advisory: "Temporary login throttles applied due to suspicious activity; if you see failures, try again in a few minutes or contact support." Will queue to send when we confirm reduction.

dan: product question — is the /batch-login (bulk token refresh) endpoint being abused? if so we should disable it briefly.

alice: yes heavy hit on /batch-login from the same clusters. disabling `/v1/auth/batch` for 10m now and monitoring. (disabled at 2809990120).

emily: pushing list of IP ranges and UA regex to WAF and edge denylist. sample block snippet: ```
# block residential proxy ASN ranges
ipset add rw_proxy_farm 94.XX.0.0/16
ipset add rw_proxy_farm 185.XX.0.0/16
# UA fingerprint
if ua =~ /python-requests|okhttp|java-http-client/ then block
```

bob: metrics update: auth 5xx count falling from 1200 -> 180 in 10m post-mitigation. token churn down 70%. Good signal. keeping mitigations on for now and monitoring.

alice: plan: keep rate-slice + WAF + batch-login disabled for 60m, escalate if we see re-escalation. preparing handoff notes for next oncall.

carla: sending customer advisory now (internal draft posted to #support-drafts). will include expected window and support contact.

frank: I'll keep the denylist and quota toggles scripted so we can revert quickly. posting runbook snippet to this thread.

bob: ready to take handoff in 1h from now (2809994100). I'll be primary follow-up. if anything spikes re-pager immediately.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied; severity reduced to P1. Continue monitoring; next update due in 30m or on significant change.
